tender_scope: Procurement of 150 units of Openwell Submersible Pumpsets for rural drinking water supply, 7.5 kW, 415V, 32m head, 18 L/s.

expected_primary_standard.title: Openwell Submersible Pumpsets — Specification
expected_primary_standard.rationale: Exact match for equipment type (Openwell Submersible Pumpset), power (up to 45 kW covers 7.5 kW), water temperature (up to 33°C), and application (rural water supply).

obsolete_cited_edition.note: Cited verbatim in tender Clause 4.1, but superseded by First Revision IS 14220:2018. Retrieval must independently rank current IS 14220 as primary.

acceptable_related_standards.title: Motors for Submersible Pumpsets — Specification
acceptable_related_standards.rationale: Governs the submersible motor driving the pumpset, supply voltage tolerances (350V-440V), megger testing (500V DC), and insulation resistance (5 MOhm).

acceptable_related_standards.title: Submersible Pumpsets — Specification
acceptable_related_standards.rationale: Closely related submersible pumpset standard for deepwell/borehole applications sharing hydraulic testing principles.

acceptable_related_standards.title: Electric Monoset Pumps for Clear, Cold Water for Agricultural and Water Supply Purposes — Specification
acceptable_related_standards.rationale: Alternative surface-mounted agricultural pumpset specification sharing clean cold water and motor rating domains.

acceptable_related_standards.title: Centrifugal Pumps for Clear, Cold, Fresh Water — Specification
acceptable_related_standards.rationale: Broad technical standard for clear cold water centrifugal pumpsets.
